title: EditSpec
description: The Act-II work order, derived from verified Act-I findings the author elected to implement. One entry per concrete change. Lanes A/B auto-apply (as tracked changes / logged re-runs) after the implementation verification panel clears them; lanes C/D are proposal-only and require author sign-off.

lane.description: A = pure writing; B = re-run existing analysis; C = new analysis (proposal-only); D = author judgment (memo-only).

locator.description: Anchor: a unique surrounding quote or section/label.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace; null for additions/recomputes.

new_text.description: Replacement text. For lane B, a placeholder bound to a provenance token until the run produces the value.

depends_on_run.description: run_id whose output supplies any number in this edit; null for pure-writing.

provenance_token.description: Content hash linking a number to the run artifact that produced it. Required for any numeric change (Execution-Provenance Wall).

justification_type.description: 'more likely to be accepted' is NEVER a permitted justification for a substantive change.

edit_class.description: Routes auto-apply vs sign-off. presentation/additive-verified may auto-apply; numeric/result-suppressing/claim-altering require author sign-off.

reverify_angles.description: Which verification-panel angles must clear this edit before delivery (always includes fix-safety; numeric edits add numeric-provenance + consistency; any record-touching edit adds integrity).
